# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.11 cross-package follow-up

Status: Deferred questions only. This record grants no authority outside RTC.

## SCI-PTC

RTC will supply conditioned $x$, requested canonical conditioned $r$ or exact
availability, raw pair identity, evidence origins, direct/inferred causes,
pair action support, common operator response, affine actions, donor-induced
$r$ unavailability, covariance status, leakage/source-protection state, and
provenance. PTC must separately define whether and how a joint-$r$ mode uses
those facts, including any explicit PTC-owned $x\leftarrow r$ nuisance-
prediction operator. RTC authorizes no default activation or subtraction.

## SCI-VAL

RTC remains authoritative for what happened to raw detector occurrences.
SCI-VAL must separately define cross-package aggregation of RTC coordinate
validity, pair actions, conditioned availability, response availability,
uncertainty, and named-use eligibility. A pair event is not itself a universal
downstream exclusion decision.

## SCI-CAL

CAL continues to consume and calibrate conditioned $x$ only. It must preserve
the complete RTC parent/plan/response/availability lineage needed by its own
contract. Conditioned $r$ is neither calibrated nor assigned a Stokes meaning.

## No silent resolution

This record does not decide PTC joint-mode policy, VAL eligibility/aggregation,
CAL numerical policy, storage schema, implementation, validation, scientific
performance, qualification, or production use.
